description: This source file defines a generic object pool class 'ObjectPool<T>' that manages pooled resources with functionalities for allocation, release, and monitoring, within the Orleans.Streaming.Common namespace.

classes.name: ObjectPool<T>
classes.description: A thread-safe generic object pooling class using a stack to store available objects, supporting monitoring and resource management.

methods.name: ObjectPool
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object pool with a factory function, optional monitor, and optional monitoring interval.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a resource from the pool, creating a new one if none are available.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Returns a resource back to the pool.

methods.name: ReportObjectPoolStatistics
methods.description: Reports current statistics of the object pool to the monitor.
